content: Christmas is coming up. Han Meimei, let me ask you a question.
No, we have Chinese New Year's celebrations.
But Christmas is the biggest holiday of the year. People are busy shopping and preparing presents for relatives and friends before Christmas Eve.
Children hang their stockings over the fireplace so that Father Christmas can fill them with sweets and toys.
What if they don't have a fireplace?
No problem. They always find some place to hang them. By the way, what are you going to do at Christmas?
My teacher, Professor Smith and his wife have invited me to a Christmas dinner.
